title: Design: the PDF-too-large message matches the design picture
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure the organization has more than 2,000 open A/P lines on today's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with every bucket collapsed.
  • Open the design picture "PDF over 2,000 rows is refused" (ar-ap-p2-pdf-over-2-000-rows-is-refused.png) (attached to this case) beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  2. Click "Close" on the message.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • One message appears at the bottom right of the window and nothing downloads: as in the picture, a solid red box with a white warning triangle at the left, white text, and a white "Close" at the right, with no title line.
  • The report behind it does not change.
  • The message reads, letter for letter, "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again."

Step 2:

  • The message closes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-N1: “Over 2,000 rows, the PDF is refused before anything is generated: no download, and the message "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again." Exactly 2,000 rows is allowed.”
  • S3-N3: “A refused export shows exactly one message (S3-N1 or S3-N2), never a second generic error.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “PDF export over 2,000 rows | "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again." | Error toast, as on the other reports; nothing downloads”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
